frozenBefore: Specified after v1's results were seen; fixed before any volatility-stratified figure was computed from the export.
interpretation: Retrospective historical research on the same export as v1. It tests whether v1's rank, setup and warning differences remain against members of similar volatility; a match or a mismatch explains v1 on this data and is not independent confirmation, prospective evidence, a backtest or a trading result.

data.source: tradingview-mcp get_ohlcv, interval 1D, 1000 bars per symbol
data.cutoff: retrieval.startedAt: a bar is used, as input or outcome, only if its session was final (9h after the scheduled close, FINAL_BAR_DELAY_MS) by then
data.adjustment: SPLIT: TradingView states regular session only and split-adjusted only; prices carry no dividend adjustment and no split events are reported
data.mapping: tradingViewSeries (scripts/tradingViewImport.ts): a bar's t must be the 09:30 America/New_York open of its session, or the whole series is rejected

universe.selectionRule: The 50 configured US equities and ETFs (US_EQUITY_INSTRUMENTS, the 90 equity rows of assets_status) with the lowest sha256(ticker) hex digests, fixed before any data was fetched or scored.

calendar.sessions: Observed: every session date present in at least one member's bars. Observed 2026 sessions must equal the published US_EQUITY_CALENDAR sessions exactly, or the study refuses to run.

evaluationDates.rule: Every observed session from the 200th (the first on which every member's data allows a full window) to the latest session final at the cutoff; the same dates for every member

decision.time: Evaluation date D's bar becomes final 9h after D's scheduled close; the scanner is given only bars of sessions on or before D
decision.earlyCloses: Known only from 2026 (published calendar); an earlier early close shifts the decision timestamp, never which bars are supplied

scanner.historyWindow: The latest 199 bars of sessions on or before D (SCAN_MIN_CLOSED_CANDLES), scored by evaluateCandles over that whole window, as the equity scan does
scanner.eligibility: us-equity-daily-v1 rules against the observed calendar: a missing, duplicate or non-session bar or invalid OHLC inside the window is DATA_INVALID; a latest bar older than the session before D is STALE_DATA; fewer than 199 bars or no finite reading is INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY
scanner.ranking: Within the equity cohort, stocks and ETFs together: score descending, then ticker in code-unit order, as evaluateScan ranks
scanner.parity: On every evaluation date whose 200-session request range the published calendar covers, the replay must equal importInputs + evaluateScan on the same export, or the study refuses to run

signals.longSetup: modelSetups long (Pine ZC LONG): score >= 78 and MACD histogram / close >= +0.05%
signals.riskWarning: modelSetups risk (Pine ZC RISK): score <= 28 or HIGH_VOLATILITY regime
signals.rankGroups: The scanner's order restricted to the population's EVALUATED members (rank among stocks, for stocks): top5: ranks 1-5; top10: ranks 1-10; rank quintile q = ceil(5 x rank / members ranked that date)
signals.observation: One asset on one evaluation date on which the condition holds; a standing setup repeats on every date it holds
signals.transition: An observation whose asset was EVALUATED on the previous evaluation date without the same condition. When the asset was not evaluated on the previous date the onset is unknown, so it is not a transition

referencePrice: OPEN of the first session after D, which opens after the decision time; D's close is never used as an entry
endpointPrice: OPEN of the session h observed sessions after the reference session
change: endpoint / reference - 1, in percent; price only, dividends excluded
maturity: A horizon is measured only when its endpoint session is final at the cutoff; otherwise it is PENDING and excluded
benchmark: SPY (AMEX:SPY, also a universe member) over the identical reference and endpoint sessions

comparisons.volatilityMatchedBaseline: Per observation: the mean change of the population's EVALUATED members in the same volatility tercile with an AVAILABLE outcome for that date and horizon, the asset included
comparisons.volatilityTercileBaseline: Volatility-tercile rows compare against the same-date population mean, as v1's groups did, to show how volatility alone was associated with the change
comparisons.benchmarkDifference: Per observation: the asset's change minus SPY's over the same sessions
comparisons.composition: For each v1 group: the share of its observations in volatility terciles 1, 2 and 3
comparisons.notRepeated: v1's same-date universe rows and SPY row: unchanged inputs give v1's figures
breakdowns: calendar year of the evaluation date

missingData.substitution: none: no forward-fill, interpolation or nearby-session substitution
missingData.pending: the endpoint session is not final at the cutoff
missingData.missing: the asset has no bar at the reference or endpoint session
missingData.invalid: the reference or endpoint bar fails OHLC validation
missingData.excluded: A member not EVALUATED on D contributes no observation on D and stays in the coverage counts
missingData.baseline: An observation whose same-date tercile has no AVAILABLE outcome has no baseline; it is excluded and counted

dependence: Consecutive evaluation dates share all but one session of each horizon, standing setups repeat daily, and same-date observations share market moves. Observations are not independent trials; no significance test, p-value or confidence interval is reported.
notReported: profit from risk warnings: a decline after a warning is not profit and no short position is assumed

volatility.measure: ATR(14) / close of the scored window's last bar: the canonical model's own volatilityPercent input on the evaluation date, so no later bar is used
volatility.terciles: On each evaluation date, within each population: order the EVALUATED members by the measure ascending, ties by ticker in code-unit order; tercile t = ceil(3 x position / members ordered). Tercile 1 is the quietest
volatility.whyTerciles: Fixed in advance, not tuned: three groups leave about 16 of 50 members (about 12 of 38 stocks) per tercile and date; finer cells would be too thin

populations.all: Every universe member, as in v1
populations.stocks: The 38 stocks only: terciles, ranks and baselines computed among stocks alone, because v1 showed its rank pattern among stocks
populations.excluded: ETFs alone: 12 members leave four per tercile, too few for a same-date tercile mean
